title: Repository Target Cache Decision
description: 💾️ Why one inferred target is replayed from a task cache or always executed. Backends read the class: only `deterministic` replays; every other class executes, and its reason names the physical fact that forbids replay.

Deterministic.description: A pure function of its declared inputs; every declared output is a plain restorable tree (or there is none).

DriverOwned.description: The command compiles through the build driver, whose Cargo freshness and stage cache are the authority; its outputs are shared between variants.

ManagedOutput.description: Outputs live in the leased products store behind a binding or manifest protocol; restoring a copy would be refused or would bypass the store.

SideEffecting.description: Mutates state outside its declared outputs: the workspace, a tool, dependency or cache store of this machine, or a remote.

Live.description: Observes or drives a running process, or exercises the real locks, storage, process tree or clock of this machine.

Aggregate.description: Orders prerequisites and does no work of its own; a verb that re-enters the build tool for other targets orders them the same way and should declare them as dependencies.

Diagnostic.description: Reports a refusal or a measurement, or answers the arguments and standard input its caller supplies, and is always re-evaluated.

Unclassified.description: No policy row, declaration or verifying command classifies the target, so it never replays until the workspace policy names its kind.
